claims.claim: President Bola Tinubu declared three days of national mourning after a military aircraft crashed in southern Ondo State on Monday morning, killing 32 people.
claims.episode_span: President Bola Tinubu has declared three days of national mourning after a military aircraft crashed in southern Ondo State on Monday morning.
claims.source_title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed in military plane crash
claims.supporting_quote: Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu has declared three days of national mourning after a military aircraft crashed in southern Ondo State, killing 32 people.

claims.claim: Authorities say the plane was on a routine mission from Benin City to Lagos and came down near a naval base.
claims.episode_span: Authorities say the plane was on a routine mission from Benin City to Lagos and came down near a naval base.
claims.source_title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed in military plane crash
claims.supporting_quote: Authorities say the plane was on a routine mission from Benin City to Lagos when it came down near a naval base on Monday morning.

claims.claim: Tinubu offered condolences for 25 passengers and seven crew and ordered flags at half-mast.
claims.episode_span: Tinubu offered condolences for the 25 passengers and seven crew and ordered flags flown at half-mast.
claims.source_title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed in military plane crash
claims.supporting_quote: Tinubu offered his deepest condolences for the 25 passengers and seven crew members on board and has ordered a full investigation.

claims.claim: Festus Keyamo said aircraft NGR 931 left Benin for Lagos at 0913 hours, radio contact failed, and it crashed near a naval base in Igbokoda.
claims.episode_span: Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo said tail number NGR 931 left Benin for Lagos at 0913 hours, radio contact failed, and the crash was then confirmed near a naval base in Igbokoda.
claims.source_title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed in military plane crash
claims.supporting_quote: Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo earlier said he had been informed "of the disappearance of a military aircraft with tail number NGR 931, enroute Lagos from Benin at 0913 hours earlier today".

claims.claim: The crashed plane is described as an ATR-42 that manufacturers say carries 30 to 50 passengers, and Tinubu ordered an Air Force investigation.
claims.episode_span: The aircraft is described as an ATR-42, which its manufacturers say carries 30 to 50 passengers, and Tinubu has ordered the Air Force to investigate.
claims.source_title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed in military plane crash
claims.supporting_quote: The crashed plane, described as an ATR-42 aircraft, carries between 30 and 50 passengers, according to its manufacturers.

claims.claim: A resident told the BBC the plane crashed near a swamp, with clothes, shoes and smoke at the site, and names will be published after families are informed.
claims.episode_span: A resident told the BBC it came down near a swamp, with clothes and shoes at the site and smoke rising.
claims.source_title: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed in military plane crash
claims.supporting_quote: A resident told the BBC that the plane had crashed near a swamp and that clothes and shoes had been found at the site.

claims.claim: Ibrahim Olabi told the UN Sixth Committee that Israel should immediately cease attacks and fully withdraw from occupied Syrian territory.
claims.episode_span: Syria's ambassador to the United Nations, Ibrahim Olabi, told the Sixth Committee that Israel should stop its attacks at once and fully withdraw from occupied Syrian territory.
claims.source_title: Syria condemns Israeli attacks, demands withdrawal from territory
claims.supporting_quote: Olabi demanded an "immediate cessation" of the attacks as well as a "full withdrawal from all occupied Syrian territories".

claims.claim: Middle East Eye reports the Israeli army killed a man in southern Syria early Monday amid ongoing military raids.
claims.episode_span: Middle East Eye reports that early on Monday the Israeli army killed a man in southern Syria during ongoing military raids.
claims.source_title: Syria condemns Israeli attacks, demands withdrawal from territory
claims.supporting_quote: Early on Monday, the Israeli army killed a man in southern Syria, amid ongoing military raids.

claims.claim: A fuel tanker exploded shortly after midnight at Sachangwan on the Nakuru-Eldoret highway; the Kenya Red Cross attended to two casualties and the road was closed at Kibunja and Soilo.
claims.episode_span: A fuel tanker exploded shortly after midnight at Sachangwan, on the Salgaa-Nakuru stretch of the Nakuru-Eldoret highway, near a General Service Unit camp.
claims.source_title: Kenya: Two Injured As Tanker Explodes At Sachangwan, Highway Closed
claims.supporting_quote: A fuel tanker exploded shortly after midnight at Sachangwan along the Salgaa-Nakuru stretch of the Nakuru-Eldoret highway, prompting an emergency response and the temporary closure of a section of the busy highway.

claims.claim: Samuel Ndanyi said investigations were under way, and a parliamentary report lists Salgaa, Sachangwan, Migaa and Soysambu as Nakuru hotspots with planned safety works at Kibunja.
claims.episode_span: Rift Valley Regional Police Commander Samuel Ndanyi said investigations were under way and that teams were checking for further casualties.
claims.source_title: Kenya: Two Injured As Tanker Explodes At Sachangwan, Highway Closed
claims.supporting_quote: Rift Valley Regional Police Commander Samuel Ndanyi said investigations were underway, with emergency teams also assessing the scene to establish whether there were additional casualties.

claims.claim: Chrispinus Wanyonyi, 41, died in custody at Chwele Police Station at about 10:45 a.m. on 5 October while held over alleged stock theft, and IPOA was notified.
claims.episode_span: Police in Bungoma are investigating the death of Chrispinus Wanyonyi, 41, who collapsed and died in custody at Chwele Police Station at about 10:45 a.m. on 5 October while held over alleged stock theft, and the Independent Policing Oversight Authority has been notified.
claims.source_title: Kenya: Bungoma - Stock Theft Suspect Dies in Police Custody At Chwele Police Station
claims.supporting_quote: According to a police report, Wanyonyi died at about 10:45am on October 5 as arrangements were being made to rush him to hospital.

claims.claim: By about 7 p.m. Monday a university website no longer showed Mr Kila's name, profile or photographs.
claims.episode_span: Premium Times reports that by about 7 p.m. on Monday a university website no longer carried Mr Kila's name, profile or photographs.
claims.source_title: Fake Professorship: University moves against Kila, removes him from website
claims.supporting_quote: PREMIUM TIMES’ review of the website around 7 p.m. on Monday showed that Mr Kila’s name, profile and photographs had been removed, leaving no trace of him on the website.

claims.claim: A senior Somaliland adviser said Hargeisa wants Israel to bolster its defences against Turkey, citing Turkish jets, drones and military cooperation with Somalia.
claims.episode_span: A senior Somaliland adviser said Hargeisa wants Israel to bolster its defences against Turkey, pointing to Turkish fighter jets, drones and growing military cooperation with Somalia.
claims.source_title: Somaliland seeks Israeli military support as Turkey expands role in Somalia
claims.supporting_quote: A senior Somaliland adviser said Hargeisa wants Israel to bolster its defenses against Turkey, pointing to Turkish fighter jets, drones and growing military cooperation with Somalia.

claims.claim: Times Higher Education ranks the University of Cape Town 147th globally, with South African universities leading Southern Africa, after assessing 2,297 universities in 118 countries and territories.
claims.episode_span: Times Higher Education's latest ranking places the University of Cape Town 147th in the world, with South African universities leading Southern Africa, after assessing 2,297 universities in 118 countries and territories.
claims.source_title: Top 10 universities in Southern Africa, according to latest ranking (2027)
claims.supporting_quote: South Africa dominates the latest Times Higher Education World University Rankings, with the University of Cape Town leading the region and ranking 147th globally.

claims.claim: A US Navy Sikorsky MH-60R Seahawk disappeared from public flight tracking after declaring an emergency at about 9:20 p.m. GMT Monday near Yanbu on Saudi Arabia's western coast.
claims.episode_span: A US Navy helicopter disappeared from publicly available flight-tracking data after declaring an emergency over the Red Sea near Saudi Arabia.
claims.source_title: US Navy helicopter disappears after declaring emergency over Red Sea near Saudi Arabia
claims.supporting_quote: The Sikorsky MH-60R Seahawk declared an emergency at approximately 9.20 pm GMT on Monday while flying near Yanbu, located on Saudi Arabia's western coast.

claims.claim: The Court of Appeal dismissed Co-operative Bank of Kenya's appeal and upheld an award to Peter Musya Kiteme of 1,777,541.28 shillings plus 300,000 shillings exemplary damages, interest and costs, after finding he had paid more than two-thirds before the bank sold his Toyota Harrier.
claims.episode_span: A three-judge bench upheld an award of 1,777,541.28 shillings, exemplary damages of 300,000 shillings, interest and costs, and said the High Court judge had not erred.
claims.supporting_quote: the learned Judge did not fall into error in law in upholding the award of KSh1,777,541.28, exemplary damages, interest and costs

claims.claim: Kenya's tourism arrivals have reached 2.79 million and earnings have risen.
claims.episode_span: Kenya's tourism arrivals have reached 2.79 million, and earnings have risen, Travel Daily News International reports.
claims.source_title: Kenya Tourism arrivals Reach 2.79 million as earnings rise
claims.supporting_quote: Kenya Tourism arrivals Reach 2.79 million as earnings rise
